name: tracer
algorithm: Ray-trace the tracer dogfood's bench scene (a mesh, its lights and materials) at a larger image size and its bench's 8 samples per pixel, and write the PPM image; the checksum takes the image's SHA-256 (README.md).
notes: Tier A (M9 item 11.32): an Mk-only row, the tracer dogfood unchanged, compared across mk binaries; no twin (another language's libm differs in its last bits, so the bytes would differ), no defect line (README.md).
The scene is the dogfood's own (Dogfoods/tracer/cases/data/mesh.scene), named through {pkg}. The quick arguments are the dogfood's bench case; the publish arguments quadruple the width and height.
The size is provisional; tools/bench verify -publish-size fixes it in the quiet window, and the checksum changes with it.
